datasets.name: e6b55597
queryLines:
SELECT
    sale_date,

    COUNT(DISTINCT sale_id) AS orders,

    SUM(quantity) AS units_sold,

    ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue,

    ROUND(SUM(profit_amount), 2) AS profit,

    ROUND(
        SUM(profit_amount)
        / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS profit_margin_pct,

    ROUND(
        SUM(total_amount)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sale_id), 0),
        2
    ) AS average_order_value,

    ROUND(SUM(discount_amount), 2) AS discount,

    SUM(return_quantity) AS returned_units

WHERE sale_date >= (
    SELECT MAX(sale_date) - INTERVAL 6 DAYS
    FROM sales.gold.vw_sales_dashboard
)

GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date DESC

    ROUND(
        SUM(discount_amount)
        / NULLIF(SUM(gross_amount), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS discount_pct,

    ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue

FROM sales.gold.vw_sales_dashboard

WHERE sale_date >= (
    SELECT MAX(sale_date) - INTERVAL 6 DAYS
    FROM sales.gold.vw_sales_dashboard
)

GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date
